title: panicum myrianthum
intro: Panicum myrianthum, commonly known as 'River Grass', is a type of grass native to Australia and parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Panicum myrianthum include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and providing relief from digestive issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
